Chapter 6938: Scram

Chapter 6938: Scram

Many greeted the lord first before starting their personal affair. This gathering brought together immortals from all over Heavenrealm, a great chance to trade for treasures and weapons.

Some also presented extravagant gifts to the lord. As the saying goes, one doesn’t strike a smiling face. Immortals also followed this. The father-son duo could be pleased enough to avoid unnecessary confrontations.

“Immortal Lord, I excavated this liquid from the yellow river in Dark Oblivion. It is a small token of my appreciation.” An immortal said.

“Immortal Lord, I seem to like this stone and wish to trade the egg of a lightning kui for it.” Another followed a different path. He didn’t care for the valueless stone, but this method was more cultured and flattered the lord more.

After all, having someone else expressing interest in his collection was a good feeling.

Many continued to connect with him, hoping to maintain a good relationship with his branch.

“Immortal Lord, I heard you have collected something incredible recently. Would you be so kind as to let us take a look?” An immortal with close ties to the branch asked.

“My whole collection is here for everyone to see.” The lord smiled.

“Brother Perpetual told me he captured two sisters and sealed them for you, extremely rare specimens.” The immortal said.

“You must have misheard him.” The lord’s expression changed.

“I see, I see.” The immortal dropped the matter.

“What can they be?” The crowd began whispering among themselves.

Treasure Immortal Lord loved to show off, hence the hosting of these private viewings. This didn’t make sense to them.

“Two sisters? What’s so special about them?” Someone whispered.

Another looked around to check the crowd before whispering: “From the nine worlds.”

“The nine worlds!” The group stole glances at the immortal lord upon hearing this.

In the past, people wanted those from the nine worlds since they were the perfect seeds with incredible dao heart and foundation. They could be disciples or slaves.

Alas, things have changed after the dao proliferation. Guardian Alliance had become strong enough to frighten Heaven Assault.

Breaker Immortal, strong as he was, stood no chance against Guardian. Now, everyone understood why the lord kept this a secret.

“It’s rare for us to be in one, let’s enjoy ourselves.” The lord smilingly changed the subject.

“Enjoy ourselves!” Many chimed in and dropped the topic.

The firmament became busy with everyone talking and exchanging items.

“You can’t enter.” Suddenly, someone interrupted the good atmosphere.

The lord had removed all non-essential personnel from his firmament. Not even immortals could visit uninvited.

However, two visitors fearlessly entered. They were none other than Li Qiye and Timeflow Lord but were stopped by overlords.

“Scram, do not block the great immortal’s path.” Timeflow feared nothing because he knew the right side to pick.

Breaker Immortal couldn’t be considered a little brother compared to someone as monstrous as Li Qiye.

“Boom!” He didn’t hold back and unleashed a resplendent attack to send the guards flying.

He held an axe with one hand and conjured a star art with the other, creating a path for Li Qiye. His courage grew a hundredfold after spending time with Li Qiye.

The guest immortals were surprised to see an overlord acting so boldly.
